summary: Four Opus 5.5 seats under an Opus 5.5 high commander lost at 21:48 on Gecko Isle to three gecko-clan people, the last commander (t5's) dying under a Tzar. The tier-1 game was even to about 10:00 and then ours: the side held 38-39 extractors from 8:00, won the G6 fight at 10:20-11:20, and the commander logged 12.8k of army against about 4.6k seen at 12:50; our advanced vehicle plant had stood since 9:35 on t4, the sprint seat, which held 6 extractors and 14.5 metal a second. The side kept making tier 1 (about 110 soldiers in minutes 10-15, 88 Thugs on t3 over the game) while the advanced constructors' mohos waited on empty stores (3 mohos at 14:00), and the lead sat in our half until 12:50, when all three bodies were sent north after his advanced constructor had been seen (12:20). The east push broke on Skuttles at spot_54 (13:52) and the west push at C4 on a Tzar, Tigers, a Fatboy and Scorpion turrets (14:29-15:45), about 13k lost for 3k by the commander's count; his tier 2 then took a dozen of our extractors from out of sight by 20:00. Seven Cutlass seaplane gunships, met by no anti-air, killed t6's commander at 20:03 and t4's at 20:27, their death blasts taking both bases, and t3's commander walked home into the Tzar block at 21:02. Nobody, the user included, said anything in the chat; every cause below is the reader's reading.

root.what: Our tier 2 stood first and the side did not turn to it, nor spend its tier-1 lead before his tier 2 came. t4's advanced plant stood at 9:35, before any sign of his (advanced constructor seen 12:20); it made seven advanced constructors and no soldier until 15:36, and their mohos waited on stores at 0 while the other seats made about 110 tier-1 soldiers in minutes 10-15 (first moho 13:05, 3 at 14:00). Meanwhile the lead of 11:00-13:00 stood in our half (0-1% in his half on t3 and t6), the plan changing each turn, and reached his C4 line only at 14:29-15:20, after his Tzar (14:35). Earlier contributor: the sprint seat t4 held 6 extractors and 14.5 metal a second from 4:00 and was fed 1,050 metal by 9:20. Reader's reading; no person spoke in this game.
